title: CmdPal: Ordinary exit does not wait for extension shutdown (EXT26.T5)

evidence: The report says MainWindow_Closed calls SignalStopAsync without awaiting and then Environment.Exit(0).
It distinguishes yielding teardown cut short from synchronous blocking before the first incomplete await.
Related issue 50349 remains open and discusses async shutdown signals but not this full deadline scenario.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the concrete maintainer reproduction to validate the proposed mechanism before design approval.
judgment.rationale: The source path supports a lifecycle defect. Related open issue 50349 tracks a broader non-awaited shutdown concern, but does not document this report's synchronous-before-await and bounded-wait cases, so treat as related, not duplicate. Runtime shutdown was not tested.

fix_assessment.rationale: No matching fix was identified in the focused issue-number search; keep the mechanism as a hypothesis pending reproduction.

issue_context.inferences: The proposed mechanism is evidence-based but not confirmed beyond the confidence level recorded; the paired action is needed to reduce uncertainty.
issue_context.summary: Ordinary CmdPal exit starts asynchronous extension shutdown and immediately terminates the process; a synchronous call before its first await may also block the UI thread.
issue_context.analysis: The source path supports a lifecycle defect. Related open issue 50349 tracks a broader non-awaited shutdown concern, but does not document this report's synchronous-before-await and bounded-wait cases, so treat as related, not duplicate. Runtime shutdown was not tested.

design.title: Investigate the reported Command Palette behavior

actions.label: Approve bounded issue investigation
actions.note: Draft only; no fork work or upstream action was taken.

reproduce.expected_result: Shutdown starts once off the UI thread, healthy providers are attempted, async cleanup gets bounded wait, and exit follows the deadline.
prerequisites: Test extension services with controllable synchronous and asynchronous stop behavior.
reproduce.version_requirement: Current main/dev build; report references main ef43bf8.
steps: 1. Close the window with one service blocking before its first incomplete await and another healthy service.
2. Observe UI responsiveness, healthy-provider stop attempt and process-exit deadline.
3. Repeat with yielding stop and repeated close requests; compare scope with related issue 50349.

actions.label: Reproduce the reported CmdPal lifecycle failure

proposed_fixes.root_cause: Ordinary exit neither awaits nor bounds extension teardown before Environment.Exit; synchronous work can block the close path and yielding work can be cut short.
proposed_fixes.title: Investigate the reported Command Palette behavior
verification: Request exit with one service blocking before its first incomplete await and one healthy service; verify responsiveness and deadline.
Repeat with a yielding stop and verify bounded opportunity to finish.
Issue repeated close requests and verify a single shutdown operation is shared.

confidence.rationale: The call order is source-supported, but neither process shutdown nor blocking service was tested and a related open issue overlaps.

plan: Route ordinary exit through one idempotent shutdown task that closes admission to new work.
Run blocking teardown off the UI thread, attempt all providers and observe failures.
Wait only to an explicit deadline while retaining ownership of calls still running.
Coordinate with related issue 50349 and test repeated close, blocking and yielding services.
